title: Unimodality conjecture for the even part of reciprocal subsum numerators
statement:
Let $\mathrm{num}(n,x)$ be the numerator polynomial associated with sums of reciprocals of subsum polynomials over partitions of $n$, and write 
$$
\mathrm{num}(n,x)=\mathrm{num}_0(n,x)+\mathrm{num}_1(n,x),
$$
 where $\mathrm{num}_0(n,x)$ is even and $\mathrm{num}_1(n,x)$ is odd. **Unimodality conjecture.** The polynomial $\mathrm{num}_0(n,x)$ is unimodal. The paper reports experimental evidence for this conjecture, which remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10512

Status: **open** according to the source (as of May 2026). “In Section , we discuss open questions for sums of reciprocals of subsum polynomials defined on restricted sets of partitions.”
source_name: Cristina Ballantine, George Beck, Brooke Feigon and Kathrin Maurischat, “Reciprocals of Subsum Polynomials”, arXiv:2605.10512 (2026).
